risk_note: F1-08bb (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 ②; landed per D10-1772, stacked on #180 F1-08ba and rebased onto main). Payout queue 执行所选: ticked pending rows → execution confirm with the pre-execution checklist (rows already in a batch, the daily cap compared inclusively) → SMS step-up code → adminCreatePayoutBatch; a whole-batch rejection shows its reason, per-row results go back to the list. One Idempotency-Key per confirmation; closing and reopening keeps the original key and body, and an unknown result is only retried with the original key and body (BR-WDR-14). Amounts only through @couli/money. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context): 24 tests; another independent Claude spec-test r1 fail (S1: samples never had a row already in a batch) and, after a second test round, pass. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); after the rebase couli-ci verify:fast run 1 and --browser run 1 green. Written by hand.

reviews.note: Codex out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604): money review by an independent Claude per ops/approvals.yaml #36 (claude-run.sh, fresh context), r1 pass, 0 S2

spec_test_review.note: tests by an independent Claude (Codex out of quota, approvals #36); spec-test by another independent Claude context r1 fail (S1 rows already in a batch; S2 cap boundary, replay after reopen), round-2 tests, r2 pass

longrun.note: PROP_RUNS=1000000 PROP_SEED=20261001; packages/money and test/properties are unchanged from main
